snippet.title: Manaftory - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gather, build, and automate.
Survive in magical lands, process resources, and create your own factory!

Manaftory is a factory-building and automation game powered by magic.
Explore mysterious biomes, fight dangerous creatures, and turn their loot into production chains.

Add to your Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3915380/Manaftory/
